title: FINAL FANTASY TACTICS – The Ivalice Chronicles

system_requirements.Graphics: AMD Radeon™ RX 460 / Intel® Arc™ A380 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 750 Ti
system_requirements.Additional Notes: * Screen Resolution: 1280 x 720 *Onboard GPUs (CPU-integrated graphics) are outside the scope of supported specifications. * The game may not run properly on systems using Intel Arc which do not meet the requirements for Resizable BAR. * The game has been tested on Windows 10 machines with the same specifications; however, as Microsoft support for the OS will end on October 14, 2025, this falls outside of the scope of supported specifications.
